acceptance_rule.order_source: historical Python short-circuit; overlapping reasons independently counted

advantage_math.binary_support_explanation: For accepted groups format=1 and overlong is equal. A strictly monotone transform on binary accuracy has exactly two levels and is a positive affine transform on this support. Standardization cancels it without epsilon; epsilon leaves only numerical scale dependence.
advantage_math.comparison_scope: Frozen calibration applied as a counterfactual to the same saved groups from all 18 arms; actual grades use the arm reward binding.

correction_decision.separate_task_advantage_diagnostic: A format-only total reward can produce nonzero total advantages while task accuracy is constant; its historical optimizer gate rejects it. This is a mathematical diagnostic and does not establish a training defect or accuracy fix.

length_contract.causal_claim: No actual length penalty influenced rewards, advantages or acceptance. Cap-terminated responses and their missing answer closures are counted; a longer-generation counterfactual was not run.

limitations: No optimizer numerical verification is repeated; saved update counters and historical receipt bindings are replayed.
No internal-development, final100, heldout response or test content is read. No model or checkpoint selection occurs.
No clinical accuracy improvement, visual dependence, model generalization, official Vero parity, or causal reward-calibration benefit is established.

Single-box correctness is an explicit format-agnostic diagnostic limited to unambiguous categorical boxes; absent/ambiguous boxes are unknown, never inferred from prose and never admitted to training.
Partial recovery debt is charged once per recorded pending directory; imputed unknown work is a conservative charge, not measured consumption.

mission_alignment_check.change_isolation: New offline analyzer only; historical source, rewards, groups, weights, optimizer and RNG remain frozen.
mission_alignment_check.claim_and_falsifier: Every saved train group must reproduce exact grade, advantage, gate, cursor and charged ledger; any mismatch aborts.
mission_alignment_check.evidence_provenance: 2286 native train rollout groups with SHA-bound receipts and certified decoding.
mission_alignment_check.main_question_link: Reconstruct effective task exposure and reward information in existing Vero-to-MRI transfer arms.
mission_alignment_check.resources_and_decision: CPU only, one process, no model loading; diagnostic explanation only.
mission_alignment_check.shortcut_and_baseline: Accuracy variation is native parser-gated task reward, not visual dependence or generalization.

native_decoding.method: AST reuse of certified independent verifier functions; exact installed loader/streaming decoder/dispatch sources checked

strict_class_variation_audit.definition: Valid class means existing strict parser gives format>0 and an answer exactly in the declared task class inventory. Correct and wrong are relative to that train record target. The full-format subset additionally requires format==1. Invalid wrappers and nonclass answers remain unknown, without salvage extraction.
strict_class_variation_audit.legacy_392_count_interpretation: The legacy correctness_varies_but_format_rejected field counts native parser-gated accuracy variation, not necessarily valid correct/wrong categorical labels or recoverable training groups.
strict_class_variation_audit.partition_rule: Category a has at least one valid correct and one valid wrong class. Otherwise category b requires every native accuracy-zero response to have format==0. Remaining native-varying groups are category c with positive-format nonclass/malformed answers. Other unknown responses may coexist with category a.
strict_class_variation_audit.scope: These are label correctness contrasts in saved responses; they do not establish image dependence, gradients, recoverability under a changed gate, or clinical accuracy.

visual_token_accounting.legacy_measured_visual_tokens_field: K4 times the recorded per-prompt imagepad positions, not once per group, not measured vision-encoder compute.
visual_token_accounting.measurement_definition: The frozen processor-only measurement counts image_pad_id positions in expanded input_token_ids and verifies image_grid product / merge_size squared. This replay independently counts the same positions in every saved completed-group prompt.

source_derived_invocation_inventory.scope: SOURCE_DERIVED from the exact bound NativeGSPOBackend: four generate invocations per completed group; accepted updates call _logps four times for old, four for current, four inside value_and_grad. Each _logps source call passes saved pixel_values. Counts describe Python call structure, not runtime image-encoder operation telemetry, caching, FLOPs, or time.
